title: 污水泵站堵塞預防~Clogging prevention in sewage pump stations
focus: 濕井、格柵、泵曲線與堵塞預兆~Wet wells, screens, pump curves and clogging precursors
summary: 本課以濕井、格柵、泵曲線與堵塞預兆為主線，從來水與纖維物辨識、格柵有效通水面積、壓力管流速情境、濕井庫存與停留進入十個相連的技術單元。每單元依機制、數量模型、驗證與失效辨識逐步操作，最後完成包含單位、敏感度及邊界的工程工作單。數值均為原創教學假設，不是特定設施實測或現場操作設定。~This course develops wet wells, screens, pump curves and clogging precursors through ten connected units, beginning with influent and fibrous-material mapping, effective screen flow area, force-main velocity scenarios, wet-well inventory and residence. Each unit moves through mechanism, quantitative model, verification and failure diagnosis, ending in a worksheet with units, sensitivity and applicability. All example numbers are original teaching assumptions, not facility measurements or live operating settings.

units.title: 來水與纖維物辨識~Influent and fibrous-material mapping
units.mechanism: 把濕紙巾、纖維、砂與油脂分開標記；不同堵塞物需要不同前端攔截與維護證據。~Tag wipes, fibers, grit and grease separately; their clogging mechanisms require different screening and maintenance evidence.
units.model: 原創教學假設：原通流面積=0.10 m²；堵塞面積=0.03 m²。模型 Af=At-Ab，代入得到 0.07 m²。適用邊界：幾何通流面積不等於泵的剩餘性能，必須對照泵曲線。~Original teaching assumptions: Original passage area=0.10 m²; blocked area=0.03 m². Model Af=At-Ab gives 0.07 m². Applicability: Geometric open area is not remaining pump performance; compare the pump curve.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「來水與纖維物辨識」的觀測點。用離線剖面圖標示纖維纏繞與剩餘通道。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for influent and fibrous-material mapping. Mark fiber entanglement and remaining passages on an offline section drawing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 只記堵塞次數而不記堵塞物種類與位置。診斷與介入：以遠端影像與前後水位確認遮蔽，依維護程序處理。~Only event counts are recorded, without material type or location. Diagnostic response: Verify obstruction using remote images/level difference and follow maintenance procedures.
units.misconception: 所有堵塞都只是泵馬力太小。~Every clog is simply insufficient motor power.
units.practice: 只改變 Ab:0.03→0.05 m²，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.07 變為 0.05 m²。用「來水與纖維物辨識」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Ab:0.03→0.05 m², holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.07 to 0.05 m². Explain the direction using influent and fibrous-material mapping, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 格柵有效通水面積~Effective screen flow area
units.mechanism: 攔污減少自由面積，可能提高局部速度與水頭損失；應看前後水位差而非只看表面乾淨。~Retained material reduces open area and can increase local velocity/head loss; inspect level difference, not appearance alone.
units.model: 原創教學假設：原通流面積=0.10 m²；堵塞面積=0.03 m²。模型 Af=At-Ab，代入得到 0.07 m²。適用邊界：幾何通流面積不等於泵的剩餘性能，必須對照泵曲線。~Original teaching assumptions: Original passage area=0.10 m²; blocked area=0.03 m². Model Af=At-Ab gives 0.07 m². Applicability: Geometric open area is not remaining pump performance; compare the pump curve.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「格柵有效通水面積」的觀測點。用離線剖面圖標示纖維纏繞與剩餘通道。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for effective screen flow area. Mark fiber entanglement and remaining passages on an offline section drawing. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 纖維薄層遮住網孔卻被視為無大物體。診斷與介入：以遠端影像與前後水位確認遮蔽，依維護程序處理。~A thin fiber mat covers openings but is dismissed because no large object is visible. Diagnostic response: Verify obstruction using remote images/level difference and follow maintenance procedures.
units.misconception: 看不到大垃圾就沒有格柵阻塞。~No visible large debris means no screen blockage.
units.practice: 只改變 Ab:0.03→0.05 m²，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.07 變為 0.05 m²。用「格柵有效通水面積」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Ab:0.03→0.05 m², holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.07 to 0.05 m². Explain the direction using effective screen flow area, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 壓力管流速情境~Force-main velocity scenarios
units.mechanism: 流量與管徑決定平均速度，低流速沉積與高流速損失需分開評估；速度不是纖維通過保證。~Flow and diameter set mean velocity; deposition and high-velocity losses require separate assessment, and velocity does not guarantee fiber passage.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=0.05 m³/s；管內徑 D=0.25 m。模型 v=4Q/(πD²)，代入得到 1.0185916 m/s。適用邊界：滿管平均流速；不等於局部剪應力或保證不堵塞。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=0.05 m³/s; pipe inner diameter D=0.25 m. Model v=4Q/(πD²) gives 1.0185916 m/s. Applicability: Full-pipe mean velocity, not local shear or a guarantee against clogging.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「壓力管流速情境」的觀測點。由流量與實際內徑計算，配合沉積與纖維觀察。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for force-main velocity scenarios. Calculate from flow and actual diameter and compare with deposits/fibers. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 平均速度足夠卻忽略彎頭局部掛料。診斷與介入：核對實際管徑及流量，查彎頭、纖維與沉積證據。~Adequate mean velocity hides snagging at fittings. Diagnostic response: Check actual diameter/flow and inspect fittings, fibers and deposits.
units.misconception: 有足夠平均流速就永遠不堵塞。~Adequate mean velocity prevents every clog.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:0.05→0.04 m³/s，其餘假設固定；結果應由 1.0185916 變為 0.81487331 m/s。用「壓力管流速情境」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:0.05→0.04 m³/s, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 1.0185916 to 0.81487331 m/s. Explain the direction using force-main velocity scenarios, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 濕井庫存與停留~Wet-well inventory and residence
units.mechanism: 液位變化反映進出流量差；過長停留可能影響沉積與水質，計算只作離線情境。~Level change reflects inflow minus outflow; extended retention can affect deposits and water quality, explored offline here.
units.model: 原創教學假設：可用調蓄=12 m³；進流=0.02 m³/s。模型 t=V/Q，代入得到 10 min。適用邊界：停泵且無出流的理想上升時間，不是允許停機時間。~Original teaching assumptions: Usable wet-well storage=12 m³; inflow=0.02 m³/s. Model t=V/Q gives 10 min. Applicability: Ideal rise time with no pumping, not an allowable outage duration.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「濕井庫存與停留」的觀測點。對照水位訊號與儲槽幾何，分列高水位警報裕量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for wet-well inventory and residence. Compare level signals with wet-well geometry and separate high-level alarm margin. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 使用總井深而非可用容積估時間。診斷與介入：用可用容積與進出流量重算，另看高水位及備援限制。~Total depth replaces usable storage in the time estimate. Diagnostic response: Recalculate usable volume/inflow/outflow and separately assess high-level/redundancy limits.
units.misconception: 容積除流量就是可保證的停電容忍時間。~Volume divided by flow guarantees allowable outage duration.
units.practice: 只改變 Q:0.02→0.03 m³/s，其餘假設固定；結果應由 10 變為 6.6666667 min。用「濕井庫存與停留」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Q:0.02→0.03 m³/s, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 10 to 6.6666667 min. Explain the direction using wet-well inventory and residence, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 揚程與輸送功率~Head and pumping power
units.mechanism: 水力功率由流量、揚程與效率決定，關閉閥或堵塞改變工作點，不能只比較電流。~Flow, head and efficiency determine pumping power; throttling or clogging moves the duty point, so current alone is insufficient.
units.model: 原創教學假設：Q=0.05 m³/s；H=12 m；ρ=1000 kg/m³；η=0.70。模型 P=ρgQH/(1000η)，代入得到 8.4085714 kW。適用邊界：定常不可壓縮泵功率，不含變頻與馬達以外的附屬負載。~Original teaching assumptions: Q=0.05 m³/s; H=12 m; ρ=1000 kg/m³; η=0.70. Model P=ρgQH/(1000η) gives 8.4085714 kW. Applicability: Steady incompressible pump power, excluding auxiliary loads beyond the assumed efficiency.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「揚程與輸送功率」的觀測點。同步量流量、壓差、功率，避免用銘牌功率代替實測。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for head and pumping power. Measure flow, pressure rise and power simultaneously instead of using nameplate power. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把電流下降誤判為節能成功。診斷與介入：配對流量、揚程、轉速與電表，再比較工作點。~Lower current is misread as successful energy savings. Diagnostic response: Match flow, head, speed and electricity before comparing duty points.
units.misconception: 耗電變小就代表輸送表現更好。~Lower electricity always means better conveyance.
units.practice: 只改變 η:0.70→0.60，其餘假設固定；結果應由 8.4085714 變為 9.81 kW。用「揚程與輸送功率」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only η:0.70→0.60, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 8.4085714 to 9.81 kW. Explain the direction using head and pumping power, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 基線與堵塞前兆~Baseline and clogging precursors
units.mechanism: 在相同轉速與揚程配對流量、電流及振動，可篩出纏繞、磨耗或感測偏差的不同假說。~Match flow, current and vibration at equal speed/head to distinguish ragging, wear and sensor-bias hypotheses.
units.model: 原創教學假設：相同揚程下基線流量=0.050 m³/s；目前=0.040 m³/s。模型 r=Qnow/Qbase，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：須先配對轉速、揚程、液性與儀器狀態；不能單憑流量下降診斷纏繞。~Original teaching assumptions: Baseline flow at matched head=0.050 m³/s; current flow=0.040 m³/s. Model r=Qnow/Qbase gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: First match speed, head, fluid properties and instrument condition; reduced flow alone does not diagnose ragging.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「基線與堵塞前兆」的觀測點。把流量、吸排壓、轉速、電流與振動放在同一時間軸。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for baseline and clogging precursors. Place flow, suction/discharge pressure, speed, current and vibration on one timeline. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 不同雨天與旱天工作點直接比較。診斷與介入：以相同揚程轉速重新比較，讓合格人員依隔離程序檢查。~Wet- and dry-weather duty points are compared without normalization. Diagnostic response: Compare at matched head/speed and have qualified staff inspect under isolation procedures.
units.misconception: 流量下降可以單獨證明葉輪纏繞。~Reduced flow alone proves impeller ragging.
units.practice: 只改變 Qnow:0.040→0.035 m³/s，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 0.7 fraction。用「基線與堵塞前兆」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qnow:0.040→0.035 m³/s, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 0.7 fraction. Explain the direction using baseline and clogging precursors, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 並聯與備援能力~Parallel operation and redundancy
units.mechanism: 以一台不可用的情境估剩餘能力，再回到共同管線系統曲線核對。~Estimate capacity with one unit unavailable, then check the shared-pipe system curve.
units.model: 原創教學假設：每台額定教學流量=0.04 m³/s；三台中停一台。模型 Qremain=(n-1)q，代入得到 0.08 m³/s。適用邊界：相同流量僅作簡化容量表；並聯泵須重解共同系統曲線。~Original teaching assumptions: Teaching capacity per pump=0.04 m³/s; one of three pumps unavailable. Model Qremain=(n-1)q gives 0.08 m³/s. Applicability: Equal flow is a simplified capacity table; parallel pumps require the shared system curve.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「並聯與備援能力」的觀測點。在模型上停用一台，檢查電源與止回閥是否為共同失效點。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for parallel operation and redundancy. Disable one pump in the model and check common power/check-valve failures. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把每台銘牌流量相加當實際並聯流量。診斷與介入：以共同系統曲線驗證並聯情境，不能只加總銘牌。~Nameplate flows are added as if they were actual parallel output. Diagnostic response: Verify parallel scenarios against the shared system curve, not summed nameplates.
units.misconception: 兩台泵必定得到單台兩倍流量。~Two pumps always deliver twice one-pump flow.
units.practice: 只改變 n:3→2 pumps，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.08 變為 0.04 m³/s。用「並聯與備援能力」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only n:3→2 pumps, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.08 to 0.04 m³/s. Explain the direction using parallel operation and redundancy, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 清理與機械隔離~Cleaning and mechanical isolation
units.mechanism: 模擬清理需要先辨識能源與回流路徑，實機由合格人員依隔離程序操作；完成後以配對工作點驗證恢復。~Simulated cleaning first identifies energy and backflow paths; qualified staff use site isolation procedures, then verify recovery at matched duty points.
units.model: 原創教學假設：相同揚程下基線流量=0.050 m³/s；目前=0.040 m³/s。模型 r=Qnow/Qbase，代入得到 0.8 fraction。適用邊界：須先配對轉速、揚程、液性與儀器狀態；不能單憑流量下降診斷纏繞。~Original teaching assumptions: Baseline flow at matched head=0.050 m³/s; current flow=0.040 m³/s. Model r=Qnow/Qbase gives 0.8 fraction. Applicability: First match speed, head, fluid properties and instrument condition; reduced flow alone does not diagnose ragging.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「清理與機械隔離」的觀測點。把流量、吸排壓、轉速、電流與振動放在同一時間軸。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for cleaning and mechanical isolation. Place flow, suction/discharge pressure, speed, current and vibration on one timeline. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 把畫面停機當作所有能量已隔離。診斷與介入：以相同揚程轉速重新比較，讓合格人員依隔離程序檢查。~A stopped screen display is mistaken for complete energy isolation. Diagnostic response: Compare at matched head/speed and have qualified staff inspect under isolation procedures.
units.misconception: 遠端停機訊號等於可接觸葉輪。~A remote stop signal makes the impeller safe to touch.
units.practice: 只改變 Qnow:0.040→0.035 m³/s，其餘假設固定；結果應由 0.8 變為 0.7 fraction。用「清理與機械隔離」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qnow:0.040→0.035 m³/s, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 0.8 to 0.7 fraction. Explain the direction using cleaning and mechanical isolation, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. Engineering assistance may demonstrate this calculation; mark assisted completion in the record.

units.title: 雨峰與故障重播~Storm-peak and failure replay
units.mechanism: 把峰流、單機停用與液位感測失準分開注入數位情境，檢查溢流與備援限制。~Inject peak inflow, unit outage and level-sensor bias separately in the digital scenario to test overflow and redundancy constraints.
units.model: 原創教學假設：峰流=6000 m³/d；平均流=3000 m³/d。模型 PF=Qpeak/Qmean，代入得到 2 ratio。適用邊界：平均、瞬時峰與設計事件尺度須標明，不能用日平均代替尖峰。~Original teaching assumptions: Peak flow=6000 m³/d; mean flow=3000 m³/d. Model PF=Qpeak/Qmean gives 2 ratio. Applicability: State averaging and event scales; a daily mean cannot replace a short-term peak.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「雨峰與故障重播」的觀測點。比較分鐘流量序列與每日累積水量。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for storm-peak and failure replay. Compare minute-scale flow with daily total volume. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 同時更動所有輸入而無法辨識失效原因。診斷與介入：用實際峰值歷線重播，查瞬時水位及下游能力。~Changing all inputs together prevents fault attribution. Diagnostic response: Replay actual peak hydrographs and check instantaneous levels/downstream capacity.
units.misconception: 只有平均流量需要納入泵站驗證。~Only average inflow matters for pump-station verification.
units.practice: 只改變 Qpeak:6000→7500 m³/d，其餘假設固定；結果應由 2 變為 2.5 ratio。用「雨峰與故障重播」的機制解釋方向，再提出一項可區分模型失效與儀器偏差的量測。工程輔助可示範此計算，但完成紀錄應標示使用輔助。~Change only Qpeak:6000→7500 m³/d, holding the other assumptions fixed; the result changes from 2 to 2.5 ratio. Explain the direction using storm-peak and failure replay, then propose a measurement separating model failure from instrument bias. units.title: 全生命週期成效~Lifecycle performance evidence
units.mechanism: 以堵塞事件、可用率、輸送量與每立方米能耗共同評估，避免將頻繁人工清理藏在節能數字後。~Assess clogs, availability, conveyed volume and specific electricity together so energy metrics do not conceal repeated manual cleaning.
units.model: 原創教學假設：電力 E=960 kWh/d；處理量 Q=3000 m³/d。模型 SEC=E/Q，代入得到 0.32 kWh/m³。適用邊界：同一系統邊界與同一日；需同時滿足出流水品質。~Original teaching assumptions: Electricity E=960 kWh/d; flow Q=3000 m³/d. Model SEC=E/Q gives 0.32 kWh/m³. Applicability: Use identical system boundaries and days; effluent quality must also be satisfied.
units.verify: 在離線工作台先選取「全生命週期成效」的觀測點。同步讀取電表、流量計與水質趨勢。保留原始數值、單位與時間，將模型預測和量測分欄；偏差未釐清前不把模擬視為現場驗證。~In the offline workbench, select the observation point for lifecycle performance evidence. Synchronize electricity, flow and water-quality trends. Retain raw values, units and times, separate predictions from observations, and resolve discrepancies before treating a simulation as field validation.
units.failure: 節省電力但溢流與維護工時增加。診斷與介入：配對相同流量與出水品質再比較能耗，列出附屬設備。~Electricity falls while overflows and maintenance hours rise. Diagnostic response: Compare energy at matched flow/quality and list auxiliary equipment.
units.misconception: 最低單位能耗就是最佳泵站方案。~Lowest specific energy alone identifies the best station.
